Promote Open Standards: Foster a community-driven approach to agent communication, encouraging innovation and broad adoption. Preserve Opacity: Allow agents to collaborate without needing to share internal memory, proprietary logic, or specific tool implementations, enhancing security and protecting intellectual property.
